privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: What stays with you, what is shared and with whom, with no fine print.

cards.title: On your device
cards.body: Courses, grades, tasks and PDFs are stored locally by default. No ads and no selling of data.

cards.title: Cloud only if you want
cards.body: We only sync if you create an account. You can use the app without one.

cards.title: AI, clearly labelled
cards.body: Uni only sends content to Google when you ask it something. On the free shared Uni, Google may use that content to improve its products.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.subtitle: Clear, fair rules for using Unipedia in your studies.

sections.title: 1. What Unipedia is
sections.body: A free study tool for university students: timetables, plans, focus, review and an AI tutor. Averages, plans and alerts are guidance only: always check deadlines, rooms and official rules with your institution.

sections.title: 2. Who can use it
sections.body: AI features require you to be 18 or over. Other features follow the minimum age for your country listed in the Privacy Policy.

sections.title: 3. Artificial intelligence
sections.body: Uni's answers are generated automatically and can get calculations, dates or facts wrong. By using the AI you also accept Google's usage rules for Gemini. If you use a personal key, it stays on your device and you're responsible for how it's used.

sections.title: 4. Your content
sections.body: Only upload material you have the right to use, and don't upload other people's personal data without permission. Your notes remain yours.

sections.title: 5. Shared curricula
sections.body: If you share a degree's structure, only send public information (name, code, credits and general topics), with no personal data.

sections.title: 6. Availability
sections.body: The service is free and may have usage limits, change or be interrupted. We'll give notice whenever possible.

sections.title: 7. Liability
sections.body: We do our best to keep the app working well, but we don't guarantee academic results. Nothing in these terms limits your rights under the consumer protection law of your country.

sections.title: 8. Governing law
sections.body: These terms are governed by Portuguese law, without prejudice to mandatory rules of the country where you live. Contact: {{email}}.
